n = int(input())
s = input()

# Replace all double underscores with a single underscore
while "__" in s:
    s = s.replace("__", "_")

winCount = 0
maxSegmentLength = 0
left = 0
right = 0
n = len(s)

# Check if the string starts with '(' and process the first segment
if s[left] == '(':
    while right < n and s[right] != ')':
        right += 1
    if right < n and s[right] == ')':
        inside = s[left + 1:right]
        if "_" not in inside and len(inside) > 0:
            winCount += 1
        else:
            tokens = inside.split("_")
            winCount += len(tokens)
        left = right + 1

# Process all other segments enclosed in parentheses
index = 0
while index < n:
    if s[index] == '(':
        closeIdx = index
        while closeIdx < n and s[closeIdx] != ')':
            closeIdx += 1
        if closeIdx < n and s[closeIdx] == ')':
            inside = s[index + 1:closeIdx]
            if "_" not in inside and len(inside) > 0:
                winCount += 1
            else:
                tokens = inside.split("_")
                winCount += len(tokens)
            index = closeIdx
    index += 1

# Remove all parentheses and their contents
import re
while "(" in s or ")" in s:
    s = re.sub(r"\([^()]*\)", "_", s)

# Find the maximum length of segments separated by underscores
segments = s.split("_")
for segment in segments:
    if len(segment) > maxSegmentLength:
        maxSegmentLength = len(segment)

print(f"{maxSegmentLength} {winCount}")
